title: An equivalence of categories preserves limits and colimits
statement: Let $E:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be a functor which is an equivalence of categories (there are a functor $E':\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ and natural isomorphisms $E'E\cong\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal C}$, $EE'\cong\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal D}$). Then $E$ preserves all limits and all colimits: for every diagram $K:\mathcal I\to\mathcal C$ and every limit cone (resp. colimit cocone) of $K$, its image under $E$ is a limit cone (resp. colimit cocone) of $E\circ K$.

source.place: Lemma 0038 (categories-lemma-adjoint-exact), applied to E, which is both a left and a right adjoint (of its quasi-inverse)
